portions.purpose: Persist ordered review and execution evidence with validated parentage, including planning deferrals.
portions.necessity: Machine replay, correction lineage and durable nonblocking findings cannot be proven from prose.

portions.purpose: Execute validation commands, reject read-only writes and verify local commits and delivery.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust callers and declared exit codes
portions.necessity: Independent review reproduced both read-only mutation and fabricated command evidence under the simpler alternative.

portions.purpose: Validate installed Council skills and strict schemas expose required semantics.
outputs: PASS report or explicit missing contract
portions.necessity: Existence did not prove actual invocation contracts in the prior Council.

portions.purpose: Define legal states, impact-bound review decisions and remote authority rules.
portions.simpler_alternative: Document the sequence only in SKILL.md
portions.necessity: Executable rejection prevents invented gates and unauthorized remote actions.

portions.purpose: Apply the state machine and bind plans, slices, tests, unique commits and distinct reviewers.
portions.necessity: One transition function prevents invalid shortcuts between START and GOAL.

portions.purpose: Exercise read-only, trivial and correction-heavy journeys in isolated repositories.
portions.necessity: Cross-process state, resume and push authorization require end-to-end proof.

portions.purpose: Capture request anchor, base SHA and worktree baseline and manage run lifecycle.
outputs: active run or inline read-only state
portions.simpler_alternative: Read Git state only at delivery
portions.necessity: Drift requires a captured start state while read-only review must create no state.

portions.purpose: Validate strict Council JSON payloads without a production dependency.
portions.simpler_alternative: Ad-hoc field checks in every transition
portions.necessity: One validator avoids duplicated and inconsistent payload checks.

portions.purpose: Compute the weighted macro-impact score and only three accepted dispositions.
portions.necessity: The request requires measured impact before questions or changes.

portions.purpose: Validate START-to-GOAL connectivity, critical branches and idempotent RUN.md deferrals.
portions.necessity: A checklist cannot prove alternate critical journeys remain connected.

portions.purpose: Bind each added code range to a real blob marker and successfully executed evidence command.
outputs: covered line and verified command counts or explicit error
portions.necessity: Independent review proved fabricated prose passed the previous validator.

portions.purpose: Regress schemas, hooks, runtime parity, authorization and session lifecycle.
portions.necessity: Installation and hook drift are not reliably visible in source review.

portions.purpose: Regress delivery and reject fabricated commits, read-only writes, lost deferrals, commands, branches and drift.
portions.necessity: Each negative case corresponds to a reproduced bypass absent from the happy path.

portions.purpose: Regress every legal and illegal state transition, review loop and unique slice commit.
portions.necessity: Per-transition failures require precise diagnostics and cheap regression coverage.

portions.purpose: Regress scoring, graph completeness, deferral and executable code receipts.
portions.simpler_alternative: Exercise rules only through Council E2E
portions.necessity: Boundary math and evidence failures require focused unit proof.

portions.purpose: Load safe evidence paths, identify code-changing commits including merges, and replay commands.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust ledger payload and first-parent diff
portions.necessity: Independent review reproduced bypasses in both alternatives.

portions.purpose: Replay ordered events into one deterministic final Council state.
portions.necessity: The last row cannot prove legal predecessor transitions.

portions.purpose: Cross-check Git, blobs, worktree, manifest, graph, tests, reviewers and all local code commits.
portions.necessity: Schema-valid evidence can still be stale, fabricated or unrelated to delivered blobs.

portions.purpose: Regress Codex template and runtime parity contracts.
portions.necessity: Codex behavior spans hooks, skills and config surfaces.

portions.purpose: Regress Council template semantics, including executable EN lifecycle and read-only wording.
portions.necessity: Focused assertions localize semantic contract drift.

portions.purpose: Render Claude-only, Codex-only and dual-runtime projects and compare operating skills.
portions.necessity: Only real Copier renders expose conditional-path and locale omissions.

portions.purpose: Render one real Council installation and run all five installed runtime suites reproducibly.
portions.simpler_alternative: Document an ad-hoc sequence of temporary render commands
portions.necessity: A reusable harness makes the claimed installed behavior independently repeatable.
